name: Member Reachout
description: Send updates to the people on a members list. An editor picks the list each copy of the frame uses (members.table.jsonl, or one such as club.members.table.jsonl — the roster Member Manager keeps), writes a message, chooses who hears it (one or more roles, or everyone) and sends it as one bcc email or as texts, one tap per person, through the device's own mail and messages apps. Every send is a row of the space's reachout_sent table, naming the list and who sent it, so it can be browsed and sent again. The owner can make the messages sent to chosen roles readable by people outside the space, never their addresses. It never changes the roster.
